pages.title: Cherenkov Singularity
pages.text: Cherenkov quartz compressed into one point, glowing the electric blue of particles outrunning light in a medium. It flickers as if something inside is still moving faster than its own light. It is the light of a nuclear reactor pool, held in one hand.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cherenkov quartz glows blue where particles move faster than light can in it. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor focused that glow into a single brilliant point.
